label: Total-holding controls checked
description: The total-holding per se link and its regress are consistent with two cards leaning on each other on a floor, where the unrestricted holding link and regress are not (cards on a floor); with C* in the holding sense and concurrent actualization they do not give a total holder unheld in its operative act, nor an operative act that cannot be lacked (co-held holder); the whole esse-side bundle with C* gives a holder unheld in every respect that is still in potency in a respect, so the potency clause is needed for pure act (giver); and the potency clause is satisfiable with something in potency (held potency). A finite countermodel shows a premise is needed in that interpretation, not that it is false.
